name: Ball Park RV Park
note: City of Center campground in the shaded town park beside the ball diamonds, on the south side of ND-25 at the east edge of town: open grass and dirt sites under trees, reached by a gravel drive off the highway; expect highway noise and busy softball-tournament weekends. The city's dump station is at the Betty Hagel Memorial Civic Center on ND-48 in town. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Center 'Parks & RV Parks' page (centernd.net/visit/#rv, read 2026-11-12): 'Ball Park RV Park, Address: 314 ND-25, Center, ND, Phone: 701-794-3502. The Ball Park RV Park has 12 spaces and offers electric hook up only ($15/night). Primitive $10/night. Contact the City Offices for rates on an extended stay. RV Park is First Come First Serve' -> a city campground on the city's own page (public ladder step 1). ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025, hhs.nd.gov statewide-licensed-rv-parks-campgrounds-exception.pdf, read 2026-11-12) row 62: CENTER PARK BOARD CAMPGROUND, 314 Highway 25 E, Center, Oliver County, owner CITY OF CENTER, Western Plains Public Health, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 10/21/2021, 12 lots. Public (local): no price gate, presence rule or Google-review screen. Google Maps 'Center Park Grounds' (campground, 314 ND-25, 47.1107277,-101.2908974, 701-794-3502, 3.7 on 24 reviews, not marked closed; read 2026-11-12, limited view showed 5 reviews): 'Pretty nice place. The bathrooms were locked but they did bring portable ones in for the softball tournament' (6 yr), 'Good short term primitive campground, good location, no water access' (3 yr), 'Well maintained and clean. Beautiful park!' (7 yr), 'Wonderful place to stay a while' (8 yr), 'Nice little campground!' (9 yr) - nothing about closure, filth or safety, so not very poor. The Dyrt review (Teresa T., April 2025 visit, posted 2025-05-01): 'This is the campground for travelers coming through town. It is very nice and at the city park ... close to the road ... the flat spots are close and in the shade and have 30 amp service' -> operating in 2025. RV Life 'Ball Park RV Park' (park 12807, 3.5*/$, 10 sites, pin 47.11108,-101.28914); its one readable review (July 2011, travel trailer, $10, power only, softball tourney). Esri imagery 2024-10-08 (500 m and 220 m frames at 47.1104,-101.2900): south of ND-25, a gravel drive from the highway at the park's east edge curves west into a shaded grass/dirt camping area under tree rows, with ~4 trailers/campers (~7-8 m long) parked there and the ball diamonds to the south-east -> drive-in, open ground where a 23-ft rig fits; no posted limits or road warnings. No horse facilities or mention. Long-stay/workforce: the city sells nights FCFS at a published daily rate and offers extended stays only on request; no count of nightly vs long-term sites exists (test 4 passes on no count); Wayback 2021-08-23 shows the camping area empty and 2024-10-08 shows ~4 units; one Campendium review (March 2019, 40-day stay, 'Economically fit for the worker') is the only worker mention. Not a workforce park: the neighbouring city park that was (6019 Center RV Park, 304 Square Butte St, monthly-heavy) was dropped 2026-11-12; this is a different, separately licensed site. Duplicate check 2026-11-12: nothing in campgrounds.json within 15 km or by name.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery 2024-10-08 (2.4 km frame and 500 m frame at 47.11073,-101.29090; 220 m frame at 47.1104,-101.2900) and Wayback 2021-08-23 (z18). The only water nearby is a narrow, tree-lined creek channel winding past the south-west corner of the park, ~130-150 m from the camping area through dense trees and past park buildings; the sewage lagoons ~600 m south are not recreational water. No site within ~50 m of water and no open view of any water from the camping area -> not waterfront. No name or marketing claim of water to re-audit.

flags: Public (City of Center; HHS licence holder CITY OF CENTER, licensed as 'Center Park Board Campground'), so the price gate and the private Google-review screen do not apply. Google 3.7 on 24: the 5 reviews visible (limited view) are all positive or neutral; one, ~6 years old, says the bathrooms were locked. The other 19 could not be opened without a sign-in.
Name: the city publishes 'Ball Park RV Park'; Google calls it 'Center Park Grounds', HHS 'Center Park Board Campground'.
Amperage (30) rests on The Dyrt (one April 2025 review plus its listing text); the city says only 'electric hook up only'. A 2019 Campendium entry said 20 A.
Restrooms not written: The Dyrt lists toilets, a ~6-year-old Google review says they were locked; nothing official.
Season not published; season left unwritten.

Long-stay: the city offers extended-stay rates on request and one 2019 Campendium reviewer stayed 40 days as a worker, but the city sells nights FCFS for travellers and imagery (2021 empty, 2024 ~4 units) shows no worker camp -> kept, no caveat (no count of long-term sites exists).
Pin: Google/ndtourism point 47.11073,-101.29090 sits in the tree row ~70 m NW of the camping area; pinned to the parked campers at 47.11040,-101.29016.

Not in the DB: the other city park, Center RV Park (304 Square Butte St, 20 FHU, $50/$150 wk/$450 mo), was 6019 and was dropped 2026-11-12 as mostly long-term. Nelson Lake (free primitive) is the separate lead 16.
curation_note: ND lead 15 (2026-11-12): City of Center campground, HHS licence CENTER PARK BOARD CAMPGROUND (owner City of Center, 12 lots, inspected 10/21/2021). Amperage from The Dyrt (April 2025 review, '30 amp'); the city publishes only 'electric hook up only'. Google 3.7/24: visible reviews positive. Not the dropped 6019 Center RV Park (304 Square Butte St). --Claude
